findings.issue: `h_ne_zero` is unused by all ten theorems of the `UniversalEnveloping`/`UniversalEnvelopingRat` sections, so the whole user-facing surface is inapplicable exactly where the module doc (lines 39-43) says it must be: images of a triple under a Lie hom, in a quotient, or after base change, where the Cartan image is not known nonzero but the three bracket relations still hold. The three bridge lemmas `ι_e_mul_ι_f_sub_mul` (214), `ι_h_mul_ι_e_sub_mul` (219), `ι_h_mul_ι_f_sub_mul` (224) each project exactly one field.

summary: The associative-algebra core sits at the right level, but every theorem in the two universal-enveloping sections demands a bundled `IsSl2Triple` while using at most two of its four fields; `h_ne_zero` is never used, and four `h`-only lemmas force an irrelevant third element to exist.
